title: RawContent
description: Immutable, versioned raw content record for news, announcements, research, interactive and social content. publishTime <= ingestTime <= availableTime (all timezone-aware). recordId identifies the content lineage; versionId identifies the current immutable version; previousVersionId links the direct predecessor. The content fingerprint is a deterministic 64-hex SHA-256 that the domain recomputes (never trusted from the wire). Updates and deletions never overwrite history.

contentType.description: Content category: NEWS / ANNOUNCEMENT / RESEARCH / INTERACTION / SOCIAL

recordId.description: Stable identifier of the content lineage; shared by every version

versionId.description: Unique identifier of the current immutable version (64-hex SHA-256)

url.description: Original URL or source locator for the raw content

availableTime.description: Earliest time this record may enter research or downstream computation

originalSource.description: Original source for a repost; absent for non-repost content

previousVersionId.description: versionId of the direct predecessor; null for the first version

deleted.description: Whether this content has been deleted; deletion preserves evidence

deletedAt.description: Deletion time; required when deleted is true, and not before availableTime

ContentSource.description: Attribution of content to its source (id / version / evidence)

evidenceId.description: Immutable identifier of the raw evidence this content derives from

LicenseMetadata.description: License and usage-restriction metadata; authorized must be explicit

usageRestriction.description: Usage restriction; a non-restricting license states it explicitly

authorized.description: Explicit authorization; usable only when true
